cleavage agent: the proteins in gel were digested by 0.02 μg/μl trypsin.
enrichment method: the clarified cell lysate was then applied to an anti-Flag column pre-equilibrated with TBS.
fractionation method: The conjugate band was extracted from the gel and then digested by trypsin
instrument: Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
A total of 1 μg peptides was injected into an Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer equipped with an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: the reporter protein was analyzed with LC-MS/MS.
reduction reagent: lysis buffer A (20 mM Tris-HCl [pH 7.4], 1 mM DTT and 300 mM or 500 mM)
reduction concentration: lysis buffer A (20 mM Tris-HCl [pH 7.4], 1 mM DTT and 300 mM or 500 mM)
